material.acceptance_criteria: A Node check parses each unit kind's GLB without error, and the browser probe prints 'moba models ok kinds=<n>'.
material.description: js/client/play.js loads a GLB per unit kind through js/client/glb.js (parseGlb) and draws it with WebGL2 instead of the flat unit quad. Asset selection (which GLBs ship) is the user's decision; until it is made, the loader reads from a relative assets path.
material.resolution: verifier gm-orch-2-2-v1-v1 at e03ee19 (local scope): units.osd has 6 model= lines; each name resolves to a GLB in js/client/models; play.js loadModels uses unit_model_names; ci.yml:2199-2201 prints and checks moba models ok kinds=6. Networked units split to a new row.
material.subject: Browser MOBA renders units as 3D GLB models from assets/Models
